alignment.method: Greedy one-to-one maximum positive interval overlap, then minimum sum of endpoint distances; timestamps only.

existing_repeat_request_check.limitation: Only existing retained receipt metadata in the enumerated quote-source roots was searched; terminal caches and unknown external archives were not inspected.

interpretation.basis: Gap intervals are directly present between consecutive time_msc values in pinned unchanged raw MT5 TSVs, and match the independent cached verifier counts. No feature, rounding, payoff, or execution engine was used.
interpretation.meaning: An unobserved timestamp interval in retained quotes is established. Whether the native stream was inactive, server history was incomplete, synchronization/cache/copy was incomplete, or another cause applies is not established. Shared timing can support a common retained-source interruption hypothesis but cannot identify its cause.
interpretation.action: Keep the fixed >5s UNKNOWN handling and original data unchanged. Do not fill prices or retune the source gate based on losses. A later separately authorized repeat could distinguish some retention scenarios, but none is performed here.
interpretation.algorithm_introduced_these_timestamp_gap: Study feature/rounding/measurement pipeline only; acquisition API, cache, collector selection, and native-source inactivity causes are not ruled out.

completion_recheck.gap_scan_reuse_scope: The earlier actual timestamp-only scan completed; unchanged raw pins and current source metadata reproduce its provenance. This recheck is not a second raw timestamp scan.
